bullets.text: Meta Sued Over Privacy Issues - **Meta** faces a lawsuit for privacy violations related to its AI smart glasses.
Nothing Phone 4A Pro Launch - **Nothing** unveils the Phone 4A Pro and new headphones, all in a stylish pink.
Google Pixel 10a Review - The **Pixel 10a** impresses as a solid $500 smartphone amidst industry critiques.
Pixel Watch Feature Drop - The **Pixel Watch** receives a significant update with new payment and reminder features.
Amazon Connect Health Launch - **AWS** introduces an AI platform to streamline healthcare administrative tasks.
Roblox AI Chat Filter - **Roblox** enhances chat safety with real-time AI rephrasing to filter banned language.
OpenAI Launches GPT-5.4 - **OpenAI** releases GPT-5.4, featuring improved efficiency and a new reasoning model.
Amazon Fire TV App Redesign - **Amazon** rolls out a redesigned Fire TV app for enhanced content discovery.
BYD's Flash Charging Battery - **BYD** unveils a battery capable of rapid charging, but requires specific chargers.
FBI Investigates Hack - The **FBI** is probing a significant breach affecting its surveillance systems.
